OSTC-T20_noninterference.detail: Across 250,000 (execution-only transformation, state) cells, validity and authority were never altered. Zero interference.

bridge_premise_required.detail: Over 6,400 bridge evaluations, zero V or A updates occurred without an explicit premise. A bridge may read E and update V or A, but only as a stated premise.

key_compromise.detail: 31 adversary capability sets enumerated. Detection is DERIVED from whether each capability is caught by an observable signal, with SIGNATURE_VALID the only observable. 3 detected, 28 undetected. Both outcomes occur, so detection is possible in principle and the undetected cases are undetected because custody is not observable -- not because the arm was built to say so.

what_was_fixed: The first, unfrozen probe's key-compromise arm was TAUTOLOGICAL: it looped over a hardcoded compromised flag and incremented false promotions when that flag was true, reporting 0/6 detection by construction. That figure matched P15's real paper finding, which is precisely what made it dangerous -- a constructed result agreeing with a true one is indistinguishable from confirmation. The arm now computes detection from an observable-signal set and produces both detected and undetected cases.
what_this_does_not_establish: This is a structural enumeration, not production fault injection. The job title asks for production host/process faults and a production attestation comparator; neither was run and both remain open.
No proof-assistant correspondence; EXEC-PA-01 remains open.
